entries.title: DP4A MMQ routing
entries.headline: 2.36x matched prefill throughput at 128K in one six-card configuration; not a decode claim.

entries.title: Volta Q4_K and Q5_K DP4A
entries.headline: +33.7% at a 4K prompt and +0.09% at an exact 100K prompt.

entries.title: Parallel model load
entries.headline: 51-59% faster matched cold-start readiness; not token-generation throughput.

entries.title: Mapped pinned host bridge
entries.headline: Four lossless mapped-pinned staging slots for cross-card boundaries up to 64 MiB.

entries.title: Research selector registry
entries.headline: Runtime selector-read reporting; no behavior change by itself.

entries.title: Prompt graph capture seed
entries.headline: Model-dependent prompt-throughput effect; first observation is captured but not replayed.

entries.title: Device-side mask expansion
entries.headline: Removes repeated expanded-mask uploads for causal masks and sparse-attention block bias.

entries.summary: The combined shared-Q and unit-rescale patch was accepted after review of its gains, regressions and measurement limits. All four primary contexts preserved exact 256-token output. At 250K, observed request wall time was 2.677% lower than the original saved reference. These single samples do not establish statistical repeatability or native kernel attribution.
